highlights: Post-training scaling is taking center stage as providers like Z.ai and OpenAI upgrade coding, cybersecurity, and reasoning capabilities dramatically without retraining base architectures.

Hardware-efficient and on-device execution are experiencing massive breakthroughs, demonstrated by ultra-compact tool-calling models like Needle 2 running on only 28MB of RAM and Liquid AI's LFM2.5-VL-3B enabling local screen processing.
Autonomous agent design is maturing from basic retrieval loops into complex, governed architectures featuring self-evolving memory systems and strict bitemporal safety contracts.

agents.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents
agents.summary: This framework introduces a self-evolving memory layer for AI agents that automatically optimizes schema structures and consolidates redundant records via validation-driven evolutionary search.

agents.title: Governed Persistent Memory: Auditable State Semantics for Long-Horizon Agents
agents.summary: Introduces a bitemporal state-transition framework that governs agent memory to prevent the output of stale, retracted, or contradictory information in high-stakes environments.

agents.title: AstraZeneca's Research Assistant Agentic System for Biomedical R&D
agents.summary: Details a production-scale agentic system deployed at AstraZeneca that unifies scientific literature, knowledge graphs, and experimental data for multi-step clinical and chemistry research.

models.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash for Coding and Agentic Workflows
models.summary: Google's updated multimodal reasoning model features customizable thinking configurations and substantial performance jumps in coding benchmarks at an aggressive pricing of $0.75 per 1M input tokens.

models.title: Z.ai Launches GLM-5.3 Powered Entirely by Post-Training Scaling
models.summary: Reusing its predecessor's 743B parameter base model, GLM-5.3 achieves major performance jumps in complex coding and cybersecurity tasks solely through scaled long-horizon environment training.

models.title: Needle 2: An Open 45M-Parameter Tool-Calling Model for RAM-Constrained Devices
models.summary: A highly optimized, 14MB open-source binary model designed to execute complex tool-calling and structured extraction within a tiny 28MB RAM footprint without relying on GPUs or NPUs.

tools.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning & NeMo Switchyard Router
tools.summary: An open 30B MoE model paired with a programmatic routing layer that directs agent execution steps dynamically to the most cost-efficient capable model.

tools.title: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode for GPT-5.6 Sol via Cerebras
tools.summary: A new API service tier powered by Cerebras hardware that serves GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14x speeds, hitting a throughput of 750 output tokens per second.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: Support for Hooks, Background Tasks, and Remote MCP
tools.summary: Google adds robust developer capabilities to its Managed Agents API, allowing background task execution, event-driven hooks, and remote Model Context Protocol integration.

companies.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-5.6-Cyber for Authorized Vulnerability Research
companies.summary: Released under OpenAI's Daybreak program, GPT-5.6-Cyber is a tailored model for vulnerability research, exploit validation, and authorized security assessments.

companies.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B On-Device Vision-Language Model
companies.summary: Built for edge deployment, this 3.1B parameter model fits in roughly 3GB and enables low-latency screen-reading, object grounding, and tool calling directly on consumer hardware.

companies.title: Google Updates Workspace with Gemini Omni Video Avatars in Google Vids
companies.summary: Google has rolled out deep workspace integrations, combining Gemini Omni capabilities and customized personal avatars to streamline professional video creation workflows.

learning.title: The Builder's Guide to GPT-5.6 Agentic Optimization
learning.summary: OpenAI's official developer playbook on utilizing smarter model selection, low-latency configuration, and the revised Responses API to build robust agent applications.

learning.title: AllenAI Tulu 3 Post-Training Guide: SFT, DPO, and GRPO on 16GB Hardware
learning.summary: A comprehensive practical blueprint for setting up custom LLM post-training pipelines locally using advanced verifier-based rewards and RL techniques without needing complex distributed clusters.

learning.title: Kaggle & Google AI Agents Intensive Recap 2026
learning.summary: A massive open educational initiative summarizing major curriculum steps, repositories, and lessons learned for developers deploying modern agent architectures.
